condition: Corrective replay found no unresolved new semantic failure. Empty-sheet fixture mismatch was resolved by reference fallback; it did not require a new mechanism.
preserved_rules: Do not broaden Candidate A merely to raise coverage; coverage is not the objective, conditional reliability is.
Do not reopen Track C because context volume is large; P2 oracle mass without a viable selector is not a resource.
Do not build A2/A3 without a measured residual resource outside A1 coverage.
Do not build compiled substrate from zero solely because Candidate A is fast conditionally (circularity guard).
Do not put formula-error feedback into the agent loop without a live causal discriminator.
Do not reintroduce model-facing SQL, required IR/DSL, scheduler, or authority mechanisms on efficiency grounds alone.
Do not expand helpers beyond search/periods/inspect without uptake-gated adoption evidence.
Do not claim benchmark-wide efficiency from exposure-enriched populations.
Do not treat representative-checkpoint absence as license to assume materiality in either direction.
final_rules: No new representative/full benchmark in this phase.
No A1 broadening to increase contact; no A2/A3/B or new consumers.
Do not reopen discovery over uneven A contact, tail-heavy substrate value, rare helper usage or absent corruption witnesses.
No formula-error feedback or corruption-witness search.
Charge substrate cost once, separate retention from rebuild, and do not credit rejected helper execution.
Freshness has no independent claim without compiled serving.
Packaging/installability and evidence communication are not research mechanisms.
Closed branches require materially new evidence at their preserved gates, not dissatisfaction with economics.
Frozen leads require separate future authorization and evidence; none is promoted by this freeze.
Preserve original primary/censored outcomes; corrective replay is separate implementation evidence.
